plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp building phase for boxing with only one weekly S&C session, so the goal is to raise strength and power without adding unnecessary fatigue to sparring and skill work. Week 1 establishes a baseline on the main lower-body lift so future percentage work is anchored to your real numbers. The main training block starts in Week 2 and keeps the session focused: explosive work first, then primary strength, then practical upper-body and trunk assistance.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength and simple explosive output with low weekly lifting volume so boxing work stays sharp.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength work and keep power crisp while adjusting volume to sparring and recovery.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift toward faster strength-speed and sharper boxing-relevant power while keeping enough strength to hold your force base.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Reset between reps and jump as fast and tall as you can. Land quietly and stop if height drops off.

substitutionOptions.notes: Use a box height that lets you land cleanly without tucking hard.

substitutionOptions.notes: Pause briefly at the bottom to remove the rebound and keep the takeoff crisp.

exercises.name: 2. Back Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up progressively with small jumps in load, then build to one hard set of 3-5 reps with solid depth and no grindy collapse. This sets your baseline for future percentage work.
